prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1105; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss by phone. Insured reports sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road. Other vehicle departed scene before exchange of information. Insured reports neck and back pain at scene and was transported by ambulance. Photos requested from insured. Claim file opened and assigned to adjuster.

Entry 2: Reviewed police report. Officer documented damage to passenger side of insured vehicle and driver side of other vehicle, consistent with lane change contact. Witness statement obtained from a bystander who saw other vehicle drift into adjacent lane. Liability appears probable against unidentified driver; uninsured motorist coverage to be evaluated.

Entry 3: Claimant is now represented by counsel. Letter of representation received. All further contact to be routed through attorney's office. Requested medical authorization and records from treating providers. Attorney indicates claimant has ongoing neck and back strain and has begun physical therapy.

Entry 4: Received initial medical records. Diagnosis includes cervical and lumbar strain with muscle spasm. Treatment plan calls for physical therapy several times per week for an extended period. Treating physician has noted restricted range of motion. Reviewing records against coverage and liability to determine next steps. Requested itemized billing from providers.

Entry 5: Spoke with claimant's attorney regarding status of medical documentation and bills received so far. Attorney requests that claim remain open pending completion of treatment. Advised that file will be reviewed upon receipt of complete records and final treatment summary. Diary set for follow-up in the coming weeks.
